reviewed_pilot.definition_en: an artistic form of auditory communication incorporating instrumental or vocal tones in a structured and continuous manner
the act of making up your mind about something
reviewed_pilot.source_example: the burden of decision was his

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: a person whose occupation is teaching
to make better
reviewed_pilot.source_example: The editor improved the manuscript with his changes

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: the concentration of attention or energy on something
reviewed_pilot.source_example: the focus of activity shifted to molecular biology

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something
reviewed_pilot.source_example: made an effort to cover all the reading material

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: your basis for belief or disbelief; knowledge on which to base belief
reviewed_pilot.source_example: the evidence that smoking causes lung cancer is very compelling

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: a financial institution that accepts deposits and channels the money into lending activities
reviewed_pilot.source_example: he cashed a check at the bank

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: to gain with effort
reviewed_pilot.source_example: she achieved her goal despite setbacks

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: a demanding or stimulating situation
reviewed_pilot.source_example: they reacted irrationally to the challenge of Russian power

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment
a health facility where patients receive treatment
recognize as being; establish the identity of someone or something
reviewed_pilot.source_example: She identified the man on the ‘wanted’ poster

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: carry out or perform an action
reviewed_pilot.source_example: John did the painting, the weeding, and he cleaned out the gutters

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: cause to continue in a certain state, position, or activity
a plot of ground where plants are cultivated
a room where books are kept
reviewed_pilot.source_example: they had brandy in the library

reviewed_pilot.definition_en: an abstract or general idea inferred or derived from specific instances
well known or easily recognized
consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning
make fit for, or change to suit a new purpose
reviewed_pilot.source_example: Adapt our native cuisine to the available food resources of the new country

case_only_headwords.explanation: IT 缩写，不能作为代词 it。
OR 缩写，不能作为连词 or。
WHO 缩写，不能作为疑问词 who。

case_only_senses.definition_en: the branch of engineering that deals with the use of computers and telecommunications to retrieve and store and transmit information
a room in a hospital equipped for the performance of surgical operations
case_only_senses.source_example: great care is taken to keep the operating rooms aseptic

case_only_senses.definition_en: a United Nations agency to coordinate international health activities and to help governments improve health services
consistent with fact or reality; not false
devoted (sometimes fanatically) to a cause or concept or truth
case_only_senses.source_example: true believers bonded together against all who disagreed with them

case_only_senses.definition_en: expressing or given to expressing the truth

case_only_senses.source_example: the horseshoe crab is not a true crab

case_only_senses.definition_en: not pretended; sincerely felt or expressed
determined with reference to the earth's axis rather than the magnetic poles

case_only_senses.source_example: the window frame isn't quite true

case_only_senses.definition_en: proper alignment; the property possessed by something that is in correct or proper alignment

case_only_senses.source_example: true, she is the smartest in her class

case_only_senses.definition_en: make level, square, balanced, or concentric
case_only_senses.source_example: true up the cylinder of an engine

case_only_senses.definition_en: not in accordance with the fact or reality or actuality

case_only_senses.source_example: delusive faith in a wonder drug

case_only_senses.definition_en: not genuine or real; being an imitation of the genuine article
case_only_senses.source_example: it isn't fake anything; it's real synthetic fur
a suitcase with a false bottom

case_only_senses.definition_en: (used especially of persons) not dependable in devotion or affection; unfaithful
in a disloyal and faithless manner
